# Vendored code instructions

Read [README.md](README.md) and the root credits/notices before changing these
files. They are separately authored code, not community-remaster originals.

Preserve license headers and version/provenance information. Prefer adapting
our wrapper over modifying a library implementation. If a vendored change is
necessary, document its origin and local delta, validate the affected decoder,
and keep the public package's notices in sync. Do not format whole vendored
headers or add generated game assets to this directory.
